classification.difficultyReason: Combine four successive durations by adding their remainders modulo 7 and interpret the result as a weekday.

content.prompt: It is Wednesday today. Christmas is 280 days away. Then 25 days holiday at the beach. Then 211 days at work. Then overseas for 143 days. What day of the week is the last day overseas? Use modulo arithmetic.

answer.short:
Thursday.

The total duration is congruent to $1$ modulo $7$, so advance one day from Wednesday.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}280+25+211+143&\equiv 0+4+1+3\pmod{7}\\280+25+211+143&\equiv 8\pmod{7}\\280+25+211+143&\equiv 1\pmod{7}\end{align*}$$

The last day overseas is one weekday after Wednesday: Thursday.
